about: Provenance of the optimizer runtime (runtime/*.py). The 24 modules were imported byte-identical from the research tree in the commit 'imported.commit_subject', together with runtime/manifest.json, the manifest written by the research builder generic_gpu/build_runtime.py (sha256 manifest.builder_sha256), which derived the generic runtime from the sealed H100 candidate (manifest of sha256 manifest.base_manifest_sha256). Neither the builder nor the H100 candidate is part of this package; git is the seal from the import on. 'edits' lists every later change of the runtime modules, one entry per commit in commit order, in the format described in rcmps_gpu/provenance.py: reverting them gives back the imported bytes, manifest.runtime_source_sha256. The optimizer command line and its worker check this before planning, before the run and after it (cli.verify_runtime), and refuse a runtime that differs; the sha256 of the manifest is also written in cli.IMPORTED_MANIFEST_SHA256.

imported.manifest_note: runtime/manifest.json as imported (removed when the package was made, since its runtime_source_sha256 no longer describes the edited files); 'manifest' is its content, and json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + newline reproduces its bytes.

manifest.full_bond_dimensions: every even integer from 2 through 512, subject to actual GPU residency

edits.commit_subject: Remove the Triton backends and dead code paths from the optimizer runtime
edits.change: pruning; the generated CUDA source, compile options and launch geometry are unchanged (tests/optimizer/golden_cuda.json). Deleted triton_backend.py and persistent_rows_general.py (Triton RHS and general cached-row solver: never imported by the generic run, only hashed into its checkpoints). Removed the code the generic launcher (cli, worker, validators) never reaches: the native CUDA conditional-graph integrator and its libcuda ctypes bindings (device_control_backend: NativeConditionalGraphs, DeviceAdaptiveDOP853, evaluate_quartic_device_control); the CUDA-graph integrator of ode_backend (_GraphAttempt, _GraphDenseOutput, graph_rhs_into, _NativeBatchedGemm with its libcublas ctypes and /proc/self/maps lookup; use_graph and use_dense_graph are now refused); the evaluators and solver classes built on them (persistent_backend, persistent_rows and persistent_rows_cached keep only the CUDA source text from which the trajectory kernel is generated); the research benchmark command lines of overlap_benchmark and persistent_trajectory_overlap with their helpers (overlap_benchmark.PreparedQuartic keeps the run/pullback of its subclass PreparedTrajectoryQuartic and refuses construction). The quartic backend label of the generic run, persistent_rows_general, is now persistent_trajectory, the only choice besides cuda; its checkpoint source hashes no longer list the two deleted modules.
